text:
All scenarios from the issue are fixed:
- 9 items at 3/page: `total_pages=3`, `has_next=False` on page 3, and page 4 now raises `ValueError` instead of returning an empty list
- 10 items at 3/page: still 4 pages, unchanged
- Empty collection: still reports 1 page

The root cause was `total_items // per_page + 1`, which always over-counts by one page when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page`. I replaced it with ceiling division `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page`, with a special case returning 1 page for an empty collection.
